title: Raise upstream: the Claude Code harness's worktree isolation refuses a git probe
why: Lane [ended:lane:-commit-refuses-conflict-markers] (#1593) met a refusal whose text comes from the Claude Code harness's worktree isolation, not from a claude-settings guard: a grep of main finds nothing (coordinator, 04:44 CST Nov 8). Sighting 01:33 CST Nov 14 (lane g1, session_013NEJKyzAd4y5QxKdrkvHxt, 01:26, relayed; refusal output unread by triage): lane lint on combined PR #3373 (head ce6de86ec346) refused two ways: check-timeout on a foreground start under 3900000 ms, and the worktree check ("too complex to verify") on the background start; the lane first said `verdict` is not installed; corrected 01:37 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 01:28, g1's own read, relayed): it exists at /root/.claude/bin/verdict in the lane's box (file dated 07:25 UTC) but is not on PATH.
note: Fix: none — the refusal text is the Claude Code harness's worktree isolation, not a claude-settings guard (grep of main finds nothing). Until: 2026-11-21. Raise it upstream. Filed 04:46 CST Nov 8. False-alarm sighting (lane git-dash-c-other-checkout, #2323, via the coordinator 17:16 CST Nov 8): the harness worktree check counts "git" inside a branch name as a second git call, so it refuses `git push origin HEAD:git-dash-c-other-checkout`. Sighting (lane encoded-retry-after-refusal, [ended:Lane:-encoded-retry-after-refusal], 17:28 CST Nov 8): in a session isolated in a worktree (EnterWorktree, .claude/worktrees/encoded-retry-merge), the harness refused three plain commands as "too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree": `python3 merge/merge.py --lane-lint 2314` (one command, worktree root, nothing chained), `~/.claude/bin/verdict ~/.claude/bin/merge --lane-lint 2314`, and the same after a cd into the worktree. The command names no git call; the merge tool runs git inside. The same command ran from the main checkout. Sighting (lane notes-fix-large-1, a builder in its worktree, 06:35 CST Nov 9): the same "too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree" refusal hit every `GUARD_SHARD=i/n python3 bin/verdict python3 hooks/test_guard.py`; the builder thinks the slash in the shard value reads as a path. Cost: test_guard.py ran unsharded, 1390 s. Not worked around. Coordinator (06:38 CST Nov 9): filing a GitHub issue on anthropics/claude-code reaches people and cannot be undone, so it waits on the owner's yes, owner page item 462 (harness-worktree-issue), which holds the draft text. Owner: coordinator until the owner answers. Bandaid for the GUARD_SHARD case: step guard-shard-value-no-slash. Fifth sighting (lane mutate-guard-cap-45, via the coordinator 07:30 CST Nov 9): in its worktree, `~/.claude/bin/merge --lane-lint 2436` was refused with the same text; the coordinator ran it instead.
